issue.title: ACP streams terminal-rendered text instead of raw Markdown

steps: Return raw Markdown containing a level-one heading named Markdown Showcase, a bullet list with First item, a two-column Name/Count table with api and 7, bold and italic text, and a fenced Python code block.
expected: ACP agent_message_chunk text preserves the model Markdown source.
defect: ACP emits terminal-rendered text, removing heading/emphasis markers and converting tables and lists to terminal glyphs.

fault location.explanation: The ACP callback ignores assistant_source events and forwards assistant_rendered events. PR #227 switches ACP to the raw source stream.

Root cause: The ACP callback ignores assistant_source events and forwards assistant_rendered events. PR #227 switches ACP to the raw source stream.

_meta.notes: The issue specifies output features rather than an exact user message. Compare the actual model text with concatenated ACP chunks, rather than presuming the model emitted valid Markdown.
